ui.lessonGoal: Handle nuance, assumptions and abstract arguments precisely.
ui.levelTip: Choose 5–6 stations. Challenge assumptions and reformulate your partner’s arguments.

presentation.introduction: Two months without school. Adventure, rest, friends, money, boredom, memories. What makes summer holidays genuinely worth remembering?
presentation.privacyNotice: You can invent examples. No one has to share private family plans, finances, locations or personal experiences.
